_comment: Expanded symbol+comment map for 8AF0237300 (2006 Tribeca 5EAT, Hitachi M32R). Merged from parallel annotation pass + verified session RE.

0x00000114.name: call_reset_vector_via_ivect
0x00000114.comment: Saves IMASK/PSW, dereferences the IVECT interrupt-vector base ((*IVECT & ~3)) and calls it, then restores creg/IMASK and tail-jumps to an unrecovered jumptable; low-level reset/exception trampoline.

0x0000016c.name: spin_forever_1
0x0000016c.comment: Empty infinite-loop stub (hang trap), likely an unused/default exception handler.

0x00000170.name: spin_forever_2
0x00000170.comment: Empty infinite-loop stub (hang trap), default/unused vector.

0x00000174.name: spin_forever_3
0x00000174.comment: Empty infinite-loop stub (hang trap), default/unused vector.

0x00000178.name: spin_forever_4
0x00000178.comment: Empty infinite-loop stub (hang trap), default/unused vector.

0x0000017c.name: reset_check_reflash_signature
0x0000017c.comment: Sets stack regs to 0x806000, scans flash at 0x0000fffc stepping 0x10000 for the 'U'/0xAA/0xCC/'3' (55 AA CC 33) download signature; if found through 0x5ffff jumps to reprogram entry FUN_00020100, otherwise runs normal boot FUN_00004000.

0x00004000.name: bootloader_main_loop
0x00004000.comment: Serial-download/bootloader main: calls init FUN_0000401c then loops forever polling receive FUN_000043f8, timer/transfer FUN_00004800 and LED-blink FUN_00004980.

0x0000401c.name: bootloader_init_ports_timers
0x0000401c.comment: Clears RAM 0x805700-0x805a07, configures all port DIR/MOD/LEV registers, interrupt-control regs (ICAN0CR etc.), timers TMS0/TMS1 (TMS0CR=0xF5, TMS1CR=0xF1), calls CAN mailbox clear FUN_000041f0, and sets RAM flags at 0x800101/116/110/117/111.

0x000041f0.name: can1_clear_all_mailboxes
0x000041f0.comment: Zeroes all 16 CAN1 message-slot registers (C1MSLn SID0/EID2/DT2/DT6) to clear the CAN1 mailbox array.

0x000043f8.name: bootloader_serial_rx_frame
0x000043f8.comment: SCI0 receive state machine for the download protocol: reads S0RCNT/S0RXB into buffer 0x805700+, validates header bytes (0x80,0x18,0xF0), accumulates checksum, on complete frame copies payload to 0x805797 and calls FUN_000047b4; drives TX via FUN_000045b8 and resets via FUN_00004910/38.

0x000045b8.name: bootloader_serial_tx_byte
0x000045b8.comment: Transmits the next response byte over SCI0 (S0TXB) from the staged buffer at 0x805700+, maintaining index 0x805831/checksum 0x805832; calls FUN_00004684 to build the reply when 0x80582b is 0.

0x00004684.name: bootloader_build_tx_response
0x00004684.comment: Builds the download-command reply: when header byte 0x80570b=='4' computes address/length from 0x80570c-712, range-checks against 0x5ffff, and fills response bytes 0x80582c-830 with either an ACK (0x80 F0 18 ..) or NAK (0x7F ..) template.

0x000047b4.name: bootloader_frame_complete
0x000047b4.comment: Handles a fully-received download frame: resets TX state (FUN_00004938), if command byte 0x80579b=='4' sets the 'active transfer' flag (bit1 of 0x805700) else clears RX-busy and re-arms receive FUN_00004910.

0x00004800.name: bootloader_transfer_timer_service
0x00004800.comment: On TMS1CT>0x7c tick: increments watchdog counters, handles transfer timeouts, and when armed copies the reflash stub (0x49e8-0x5f28) into RAM at 0x804000 and jumps to it; otherwise resets RX/TX via FUN_00004910/38 and FUN_00004684.

0x00004910.name: bootloader_rx_rearm
0x00004910.comment: Resets SCI0 receive state: clears 0x805705/706 and RX-busy bit of 0x805700, sets S0RCNT=0x10 to re-enable receive.

0x00004938.name: bootloader_tx_reset
0x00004938.comment: Resets SCI0 transmit state: clears TX index/flags at 0x805831/82b/82a/704/832 and clears S0TCNT bit0 to disable transmit.

0x00004980.name: bootloader_led_blink
0x00004980.comment: On TMS0CT>0xf9 tick, toggles P7DATA bit4 (heartbeat/status LED) and resets TMS0CT.

0x000049c8.name: saturating_inc_byte
0x000049c8.comment: Increments the byte at *param_1, saturating at 0xFF (does not wrap).

0x00005a68.name: set_flag_and_reset_rx
0x00005a68.comment: Sets bit 0x40 (clearing bit 0x20) in 0x805834 and resets S0RCNT=0; small download-state flag helper.

0x00020100.name: reflash_reprogram_main
0x00020100.comment: Flash-reprogram entry after download signature match: reinitializes all ports, blank-checks/erases flash region 0x804000-0x806000, verifies additive checksum (DAT_8000/8004), copies calibration banks from 0x8024-8029 page pointers into RAM 0x806000-0x80e000, clears app RAM, then runs full app init (CAN FUN_00021ad0, FUN_0002127c, timers, A/D) and enters the main scheduler FUN_00020a28.

0x00020824.name: profile_timer_mark
0x00020824.comment: Task execution-time profiler: on first call latches TMS0CT into 0x804be0, on second call stores elapsed TMS0CT delta into table (&DAT_00804be4)[slot] and accumulates into 0x804be2; used to time each scheduler slot.

0x000208a8.name: init_timers_ad_interrupts
0x000208a8.comment: Configures interrupt-control (IAD0CCR, ISIO1RXCR, ITOP89CR), priority (PRS0-2), TIN/TIO/TOP timer interrupt masks and channel control regs (TIO03CR/TIO4-9CR), DMA masks, and starts timers TMS0/TMS1/TML0/TML1; main real-time timer setup.

0x00020a28.name: scheduler_main_loop
0x00020a28.comment: Top-level background loop: repeatedly calls the watchdog/idle refresh FUN_00020e00 forever.

0x00020a38.name: task_dispatcher_timer_isr
0x00020a38.comment: Timer-driven cooperative task dispatcher: on TOP89 interrupt walks bitmask DAT_00804c08, and for each set bit clears it and runs the corresponding task slot function (FUN_00020e70,20f8c,20f98,...2124c) bracketed by profiler FUN_00020824; also services watchdog LED via FUN_00020e1c on TIO03.

0x00020dec.name: clear_task_scheduler_state
0x00020dec.comment: Resets the task-dispatcher state: zeroes slot index 0x804c0a and pending-task bitmask 0x804c08.

0x00020e00.name: reload_watchdog_counter
0x00020e00.comment: Under interrupt lock (FUN_0005f45c/450) reloads watchdog/idle counter DAT_00804c10 from calibration DAT_0001cd3e.

0x00020e1c.name: watchdog_led_heartbeat
0x00020e1c.comment: Decrements idle counter 0x804c10 and, if the |0x804c14-0x804c12| loop-count delta is below threshold DAT_0001cd3c, toggles P7DATA bit4 as a running heartbeat; increments 0x804c12 each call.

0x00020e70.name: task_slot1_inputs_range
0x00020e70.comment: Highest-rate task slot: increments loop counter 0x804c14, latches fail-safe flags (0x8048fe/ff), reads inhibitor switches P0.4-7 XOR DAT_0001c2e9 to detect Park/Neutral (updates 0x80466c), then runs input/CAN/solenoid subtasks FUN_00022c94, 24310, 21a68, 26c78/2706c/220e0, 2554c, 30000, 217c4.

0x00020f8c.name: task_slot_can_rx_copy
0x00020f8c.comment: Task slot wrapper calling CAN receive-mailbox copy FUN_00022090.

0x00020f98.name: task_slot_speed_solenoid
0x00020f98.comment: Task slot: when not in reflash mode (0x804f3b bit0 clear) runs wheel/turbine speed calc FUN_00024ae8 and FUN_000271f4.

0x00020fb4.name: task_slot_lockup_pwm
0x00020fb4.comment: Task slot: runs lockup/duty solenoid updates FUN_00024b90 and FUN_00024af8 (when not reflashing), then CAN mailbox transmit FUN_00021fb8.

0x00020fd4.name: task_slot_shift_control_a
0x00020fd4.comment: Task slot invoking a large block of transmission shift-control/hydraulic subtasks (FUN_0003020c, 2c7ac..2e870, 31cb8, 5307c, 51694, etc.) when not reflashing.

0x00021024.name: task_slot_shift_control_b
0x00021024.comment: Task slot invoking shift-logic/diagnostic subtasks (FUN_00045a40, 53858, 34fb0, 501dc, 4bea8..30a48, 57d24) when not reflashing.

0x00021060.name: task_slot_shift_control_c
0x00021060.comment: Task slot: runs another shift/monitor subtask group (FUN_00049880..58304) plus optional pair gated by 0x805092, and always calls FUN_00032cfc and FUN_0005e9b0.

0x000210b8.name: task_slot_shift_control_d
0x000210b8.comment: Task slot invoking subtask group FUN_0003d1ac, 53984, 4d3c4, 4ed48, 4c350, 51334, 501cc, 471d0, 3fb90, 5500c when not reflashing.

0x000210f4.name: task_slot_shift_control_e
0x000210f4.comment: Task slot invoking subtask group FUN_000335a0, 4d82c, 48010, 35c84, 55ec8 when not reflashing.

0x0002111c.name: task_slot_shift_control_f
0x0002111c.comment: Task slot invoking subtask group FUN_0004ca3c, 51618, 3798c, 3ddf0, 49848, 44670, 41c7c, 4314c, 3fd0c when not reflashing.

0x00021154.name: task_slot_shift_control_g
0x00021154.comment: Task slot invoking subtask group FUN_000562d8, 36108, 3e5c8, 41ce4, 4ca54, 30c7c when not reflashing.

0x00021180.name: task_slot_shift_control_h
0x00021180.comment: Large task slot invoking ~25 monitor/diagnostic subtasks (FUN_0005759c, 4831c, 379c4, 5bed0, ..., 4ba3c) when not reflashing.

0x000211e4.name: task_slot_conditional_single
0x000211e4.comment: Task slot: when not reflashing and flag 0x805092==0, calls single subtask FUN_0003c168.

0x00021204.name: task_slot_shift_control_i
0x00021204.comment: Task slot invoking FUN_0005ea60, 5bbf8, 44d98 when not reflashing.

0x00021224.name: task_slot_shift_control_j
0x00021224.comment: Task slot invoking FUN_000551ac, 5525c, 5530c, 37b4c, 5e73c when not reflashing.

0x0002124c.name: task_slot_shift_control_k
0x0002124c.comment: Task slot invoking FUN_000306e0, 30c6c, 30b7c, 4ba00, 302fc, 5bac0, 58340 when not reflashing.

0x0002127c.name: init_calibration_shadow_vars
0x0002127c.comment: Copies many calibration constants from flash (0x1cbd8.., 0x1cd14.., 0x12f38, 0x15e66/4c/f28, 0x161f8) into RAM working variables (0x80506x, 0x80495x, 0x80508x, 0x804ea0/ea4, etc.), seeds range/inhibitor state, and calls FUN_0002a0f4, FUN_00029b90, FUN_0005a0c8/1bc, FUN_0003dee8; part of app startup.

0x0002164c.name: reflash_write_loop_with_service
0x0002164c.comment: Reflash download service loop: waits for command 0x8047f3==0x84 / calibration flag, keeps solenoids driven and A/D + inhibitor serviced while polling AD0DT14 vs threshold; on ignition-off condition performs the full re-init sequence (copy cal banks, FUN_00021ad0, FUN_0002127c, timers) and re-enters scheduler.

0x000217c4.name: ignition_off_shutdown_learn_store
0x000217c4.comment: Detects ignition/A-D drop (AD0DT14<threshold 0x1ce4e for 0x1ce4c counts), then on power-down snapshots learned data: shuts down timers/outputs, saves 34-byte learned block from 0x80509e into rotating EEPROM buffers 0x80400e (index 0x80400a), calls FUN_00028940, FUN_0005ed3c, reflash-store FUN_0002164c/223e4, then halts in an infinite loop.

0x00021a68.name: copy_adc_results_block
0x00021a68.comment: When A/D scan complete (AD0SCM0 bit2), copies the 16 A/D result registers AD0DT0.. into RAM shadow 0x804c18 and re-triggers the scan (AD0SCM0|=1); flags 0x804c38 bit0.

0x00021ad0.name: can0_init_mailboxes
0x00021ad0.comment: Initializes CAN0: loads mailbox config tables 0x1ce08/0x1ce18/0x1ce28 into RAM 0x804c69/79/8a, sets CAN0CONF=0x940/BRP=7, global+local masks, programs 16 message slots' DLC/SID/CNT, retries up to 2x and returns 0 on program-verify failure. (can_init_mailboxes)

0x00021cfc.name: can1_clear_all_mailboxes_dup
0x00021cfc.comment: Zeroes all 16 CAN1 message-slot registers (C1MSLn SID0/EID2/DT2/DT6); duplicate of FUN_000041f0 used in app init.

0x00021f04.name: can0_rx_mailbox_read
0x00021f04.comment: For CAN0 mailbox index param_1: if new-message bit set, latches receive-complete flag, clears CNT, copies received data bytes from C0MSL0DT0[] into RAM buffer 0x804cba, and sets the mailbox re-enable bit.

0x00021fb8.name: can0_service_rx_mailboxes
0x00021fb8.comment: If CAN0 not disabled (0x805628 bit0) and no bus-off (CAN0STAT 0x4000), iterates the 16 mailboxes and calls FUN_00021f04 for each receive mailbox (config bit 0x80 set).

0x00022008.name: can0_tx_mailbox_load
0x00022008.comment: For CAN0 mailbox param_1: copies data bytes from RAM buffer 0x804cba into transmit mailbox regs C0MSL0DT0[], sets transmit-request bit 0x40 and flags 0x804caa bit2 (can_tx helper).

0x00022090.name: can0_service_tx_mailboxes
0x00022090.comment: If CAN0 enabled and no bus-off, iterates 16 mailboxes and calls FUN_00022008 for each transmit mailbox (config bit 0x40 set).

0x000220e0.name: can_bus_off_timeout_monitor
0x000220e0.comment: Monitors CAN0STAT bus-off/error-passive bits; if flag 0x8050e6==1 and self-test FUN_0003c8b4(0x1b) passes, accumulates error counter 0x8046a2 and sets fault bit 0x804929 when it exceeds calibration DAT_0001d70a; else resets via FUN_000221ac.

0x000221ac.name: can_error_counter_reset
0x000221ac.comment: Clears CAN error flag (0x804929 bit0) and error counter 0x8046a2.

0x000221c4.name: eeprom_verify_learned_blocks
0x000221c4.comment: Verifies stored learned/calibration data in serial EEPROM: reads signature at 0x50 (expect 0x11ee/0x22dd) via FUN_000225d0, reads two bank copies (base 0x60/0xf0) and their checksums, sets validity words 0x8053be/0x8053c2, and erases (FUN_00022ab8) on mismatch.

0x000223e4.name: eeprom_write_learned_blocks
0x000223e4.comment: Writes the learned-data blocks back to serial EEPROM: sets progress marker 0x8053bc, optionally erases command sectors, then writes 0x88-word block from 0x804002 and 0x8a-word block from 0x804114 via FUN_000226c0/0002271c with signature bytes 0x11ee/0x22dd and 0x5a00 tags.

0x000225d0.name: eeprom_read_word
0x000225d0.comment: Reads one 16-bit word from the SPI serial EEPROM at address param_1: asserts CS (FUN_00022958), shifts out the (addr|0x1800)<<3 read command (FUN_0002286c), clocks in 16 bits (FUN_000228f4), deasserts CS.

0x00022618.name: eeprom_read_block_checksum
0x00022618.comment: Reads param_3 words from EEPROM starting at address param_1 into buffer param_2 via FUN_000225d0, accumulating a byte checksum (nonzero + high-byte) returned in local_5.

0x000226c0.name: eeprom_write_word
0x000226c0.comment: Writes one 16-bit word param_2 to serial EEPROM address param_1: WREN (FUN_00022834), delay, CS assert, shifts (addr|0x1400)<<3 write command + 16 data bits, CS deassert, poll-delay, then WRDI (FUN_00022850).

0x0002271c.name: eeprom_write_block_checksum
0x0002271c.comment: Writes param_3 words from buffer param_2 to EEPROM starting at address param_1 via FUN_000226c0, accumulating a byte checksum; also polls A/D for ignition-off mid-write and triggers full re-init/shutdown if power drops.

0x00022834.name: eeprom_write_enable
0x00022834.comment: Sends the EEPROM WREN command (0x9800 pattern) with CS bracketing (FUN_00022958/0002286c/22968).

0x00022850.name: eeprom_write_disable
0x00022850.comment: Sends the EEPROM WRDI/command 0x8000 with CS bracketing; write-disable helper.

0x0002286c.name: eeprom_shift_out_bits
0x0002286c.comment: Bit-bangs param_2 bits of param_1 MSB-first out the EEPROM DI line (RAM bit at 0x800706 bit5), clocking each bit via FUN_00022978 and servicing the LED via FUN_00022a90.

0x000228f4.name: eeprom_shift_in_bits
0x000228f4.comment: Clocks in param_1 bits from the EEPROM DO line (P6DATA bit6), assembling them MSB-first into the returned value; toggles clock via FUN_00022978.

0x00022958.name: eeprom_cs_assert
0x00022958.comment: Asserts EEPROM chip-select by setting P7DATA bit6.

0x00022968.name: eeprom_cs_deassert
0x00022968.comment: Deasserts EEPROM chip-select by clearing P7DATA bit6.

0x00022978.name: eeprom_clock_pulse
0x00022978.comment: Generates one SPI clock pulse on P6DATA bit4 (high then low) with short delays (FUN_000229a8) between edges.

0x000229a8.name: eeprom_bit_delay
0x000229a8.comment: Short busy-wait timed by timer TMS1: resets TMS1CT, enables TMS1, spins until the compare register at 0x8003d0 reaches param_1, servicing LED via FUN_00022a90.

0x000229f8.name: eeprom_poll_delay_with_ignition_check
0x000229f8.comment: Delay of param_1 TML1CT ticks used during EEPROM writes, servicing LED FUN_00022a90; if A/D shows ignition-off it performs the full re-init/shutdown sequence and re-enters the scheduler.

0x00022a90.name: led_toggle_on_timeout
0x00022a90.comment: If TMS0CT>999, toggles the status LED (P7DATA bit4) and resets TMS0CT; periodic heartbeat during blocking waits.

0x00022ab8.name: clear_learned_data_block
0x00022ab8.comment: Clears a RAM learned-data block: param_1==0 zeros 0x89 words at 0x804000 plus bytes 0x80509e-0bf; param_1==1 zeros 0x8b words at 0x804114, seeds 0x24 entries at 0x80414a to 0x100, and loads default pressure/ratio calibrations (0x15f20/15ed6).

0x00022c94.name: dispatch_state_handler_5fd1c
0x00022c94.comment: State-machine dispatcher: if flag 0x804d6a bit0 clear, sets busy flag and calls the handler from function-pointer table PTR_FUN_0005fd1c indexed by state 0x804d6b (mask ~3).

0x00022cd8.name: eeprom_readback_state_step
0x00022cd8.comment: Reads consecutive EEPROM words (FUN_000240c0) into buffer 0x804dae starting at address 0x14, advancing pointer/index until >0x1b words read, then advances state 0x804d6b to 1.

0x00023f18.name: lcd_serial_shift_char
0x00023f18.comment: Drives an external serial device (LCD/instrument) bit by bit: reads bit pattern from table PTR_DAT_0001ce50[0x804d6e+3] and toggles data/clock lines via FUN_00024054/64/80/90/240a0/240b0 (P3DATA bits); handles special index ranges and P1DATA bit2 readback into 0x804d70.

0x00024054.name: set_p3_bit3
0x00024054.comment: Sets P3DATA bit3 (serial output line high).

0x00024080.name: set_p3_bit2
0x00024080.comment: Sets P3DATA bit2 (serial output line high).

0x00024090.name: clear_p3_bit2
0x00024090.comment: Clears P3DATA bit2 (serial output line low).

0x000240a0.name: set_p3_bit1
0x000240a0.comment: Sets P3DATA bit1 (serial output/clock line high).

0x000240b0.name: clear_p3_bit1
0x000240b0.comment: Clears P3DATA bit1 (serial output/clock line low).

0x000240c0.name: eeprom_read_word_locked
0x000240c0.comment: Reads a 16-bit word from serial EEPROM address param_1 (command (addr|0x1800)<<3) using the interrupt-safe CS helpers FUN_00024268/24284 and shift routines FUN_00024184/24208; interrupt-context variant of FUN_000225d0.

0x00024108.name: eeprom_write_word_locked
0x00024108.comment: Writes 16-bit word param_2 to serial EEPROM address param_1 (command (addr|0x1400)<<3) via the interrupt-safe CS/shift helpers; variant of FUN_000226c0.

0x0002414c.name: eeprom_write_enable_locked
0x0002414c.comment: Sends EEPROM WREN command (0x9800) using interrupt-safe CS helpers FUN_00024268/24284.

0x00024168.name: eeprom_write_disable_locked
0x00024168.comment: Sends EEPROM command 0x8000 (write-disable) using interrupt-safe CS helpers.

0x00024184.name: eeprom_shift_out_bits_locked
0x00024184.comment: Bit-bangs param_2 bits of param_1 MSB-first out the EEPROM DI line (RAM 0x800706 bit5), clocking each via FUN_000242a0; interrupt-safe variant of FUN_0002286c.

0x00024208.name: eeprom_shift_in_bits_locked
0x00024208.comment: Clocks in param_1 bits from the EEPROM DO line (P6DATA bit6) assembling the word MSB-first; interrupt-safe variant of FUN_000228f4.

0x00024268.name: eeprom_cs_assert_locked
0x00024268.comment: Asserts EEPROM chip-select (P7DATA bit6) under interrupt lock FUN_0005f45c/450.

0x00024284.name: eeprom_cs_deassert_locked
0x00024284.comment: Deasserts EEPROM chip-select (P7DATA bit6) under interrupt lock.

0x000242a0.name: eeprom_clock_pulse_locked
0x000242a0.comment: Generates one SPI clock pulse on P6DATA bit4 with tiny delays FUN_000242d0; interrupt-safe variant of FUN_00022978.

0x000242d0.name: eeprom_tiny_delay
0x000242d0.comment: Very short delay: resets TMS1CT, spins while param_1 nonzero, then clears TMS1CR bit0.

0x00024310.name: dispatch_state_handler_5fd80
0x00024310.comment: Second state-machine dispatcher (table PTR_FUN_0005fd80): when flag 0x804d6a bit0 set, selects state 0x804d6b based on 0x804d6a bit1 and 0x804d69 bit5, sets busy flag and calls the indexed handler.

0x0002439c.name: eeprom_erase_init_state
0x0002439c.comment: EEPROM erase/init state step: on first entry issues WREN and writes 0xffff to address 0x24 (FUN_0002414c/24108), sets a 10-count delay 0x804d6f, then counts down and advances state 0x804d6b to 1 when done.

0x000245ac.name: eeprom_readback_state_step2
0x000245ac.comment: Reads consecutive EEPROM words (FUN_000240c0) into buffer 0x804dce starting at address 0x24, advancing until >0x41 words read, then advances state 0x804d6b to 4.

0x00024714.name: speed_capture_isr_ch3
0x00024714.comment: Input-capture handler for TML0MR3 (a speed/pulse channel): latches TML0MR3 into 0x804e64, increments pulse counter 0x804e68, and over calibrated windows 0x804eea/eec computes period-averaged frequency into 0x804ea0/ea4 with ready flags in 0x804eac.

0x000247f8.name: speed_capture_isr_ch2
0x000247f8.comment: Input-capture handler for TML0MR2: latches TML0MR2 into 0x804eb8 and increments pulse counter 0x804ebc (saturating at -1).

0x00024814.name: speed_capture_isr_ch1
0x00024814.comment: Input-capture handler for TML0MR1: latches TML0MR1 into 0x804ed0 and increments pulse counter 0x804ed4.

0x00024830.name: speed_capture_isr_ch0
0x00024830.comment: Input-capture handler for TML0MR0: latches TML0MR0 into 0x804e84, increments pulse counter 0x804e88 and window counters 0x804e8c/e90.

0x0002486c.name: timer_input_capture_dispatch
0x0002486c.comment: TIN20-23 input-capture interrupt dispatcher: checks pending bits in TIN2023IMS / RAM 0x80023e and calls the per-channel capture handlers FUN_00024714/247f8/24814/24830, clearing each pending flag.

0x0002492c.name: init_speed_calc_constants
0x0002492c.comment: Loads speed-calculation calibration constants: window sizes 0x804e60/e80 from 0x1cc11/12 and 0x804eb0 from 0x15f1e.

0x00024954.name: compute_output_speed
0x00024954.comment: Computes an output/turbine speed from capture channel: under interrupt lock reads pulse count 0x804e68 and timestamp 0x804e64, and derives period-based speed 0x804e74 = -(prev-now)/count (or timeout-zeroes it after 0x804e60 idle counts); stores to 0x804ee4.

0x00024a20.name: compute_wheel_speed
0x00024a20.comment: Second speed computation from channel 0 captures (0x804e88/e84): derives speed 0x804e94 = -(prev-now)/count or zeros it after timeout 0x804e80 idle counts.

0x00024ae8.name: update_both_speeds
0x00024ae8.comment: Calls both speed calculators FUN_00024954 and FUN_00024a20 to refresh output and wheel speeds.

0x00024af8.name: latch_solenoid_output_bits
0x00024af8.comment: Under interrupt lock copies computed solenoid-enable bits from 0x804eee[] into hardware output shadow RAM at 0x800701/702/70b (masks 2, 0xca, 8); applies solenoid drive states.

0x00024b68.name: init_pwm_period_constants
0x00024b68.comment: Loads PWM period/limit constants 0x804f00/f02/f04 from calibration 0x1cbfc/cbf6/cbf8 (lockup/duty solenoid frequency bounds).

0x00024b90.name: update_lockup_solenoid_pwm
0x00024b90.comment: Updates the 7 TIO PWM channels (TIO2/4/5/6/7/8/9) for the linear/lockup solenoids: clamps each duty 0x804ef*/efc/efe to [0x804f02,0x804f04], and on 0/full/normal cases programs the TIOnCT/RLn compare regs, P8 mode/data, FF015/FF1620 fifo and TIOCEN enable bits; drives current-controlled solenoid PWM at 750Hz.

0x0002554c.name: selfdiag_serial_dispatch
0x0002554c.comment: Self-diagnosis serial (K-line/SSM) dispatcher: runs line-state monitor FUN_00025594 then routes to receive/transmit handlers FUN_000258d8, 27dcc, 28b08 based on protocol flags 0x805260/261/805b00; ends with FUN_00027204.

0x00025594.name: selfdiag_kline_wake_detect
0x00025594.comment: Monitors the diagnostic K-line input (P8DATA bit4) high/low durations (counters 0x805116/118), detects the wake/init pulse pattern, and on a valid init programs the DMA/timer receive engine (RAM 0x800101/117/110/116) with a baud constant selected by 0x80511f bits (0x67/0x33/0x19); starts SSM communication.

0x000258d8.name: selfdiag_tx_response_pump
0x000258d8.comment: Under interrupt lock, drives the diagnostic response transmit: decrements timers 0x80526e/counts idle 0x805120, and when a request is pending builds/sends the next response chunk (FUN_00025d10, DMA setup at 0x800440) or on the special command 0x805261 bit4 copies the reflash stub to RAM 0x804000 and jumps to it.

0x00025ad8.name: selfdiag_rx_dispatch
0x00025ad8.comment: Diagnostic receive dispatcher: routes to normal receive FUN_00025b0c, reflash-mode receive FUN_00028da8, or busy-handler FUN_00027b80 based on flags 0x805261 bit0 and 0x805b00 bit0.

0x00025b0c.name: selfdiag_rx_frame
0x00025b0c.comment: SSM/diagnostic receive state machine: reads S0RCNT/S0RXB into buffer 0x8051c8, validates the header (0x80,0x18,0xF0) and length/checksum, and on a complete request sets busy flag 0x805261 and programs the DMA response engine (RAM 0x800440/450) to echo/process; resets on error via FUN_00026948/2697c/269c0.

0x00025d10.name: selfdiag_build_response_by_cmd
0x00025d10.comment: Builds the SSM response payload (bytes 0x805124-127) based on request command 0x805138: address-read (0xA0/0xA8/0xB0 modes read memory via FUN_000269cc/26b88 or table PTR_DAT_0001cf00), ECU-ID (0x81), block reads, and the security/seed-key challenge path (cmd 0x27 with FUN_00026694).

0x00026694.name: selfdiag_seed_key_compute
0x00026694.comment: Computes the SSM security seed/key: seeds from timer TML0CT, runs 16 rounds of a nibble-substitution (table 0x5fd9c/0x5fdbc) and bit-rotation scramble, storing the 4-byte challenge to 0x805266 and the 4-byte response key to 0x805262.

0x00026814.name: selfdiag_write_command_apply
0x00026814.comment: Applies an SSM write/memory command from receive buffer 0x805134: validates the command byte, and for write-block (0xB0) copies bytes into target memory or for single-write (0xB8) writes one byte via table PTR_DAT_0001cf00; sets/clears the write-accepted flag 0x805261 bit2.

0x00026948.name: selfdiag_rx_rearm
0x00026948.comment: Resets SSM receive: clears buffer index/checksum 0x8051c6/c7 and busy bit, sets SIO3 enable bit and S0RCNT=0x10 to re-arm receive.

0x0002697c.name: selfdiag_tx_state_reset
0x0002697c.comment: Resets SSM transmit-build state: zeros counters 0x805128/122/121/259/123 and clears S0TCNT bit0.

0x000269c0.name: selfdiag_dma_stop
0x000269c0.comment: Stops the diagnostic DMA channel by writing DM3CNT0=0.

0x000269cc.name: read_memory_byte_guarded
0x000269cc.comment: Reads the byte at *param_1 for a diagnostic memory-read, but returns 0xFF if flash-protect flag DAT_0001cefc bit2 is set and the address is in flash (0..0x80000).

0x000269f8.name: selfdiag_dma_done_check
0x000269f8.comment: If DMA channel 04 done bit (DM04ITST bit3) is set, calls the transfer-complete handler FUN_00026a10.

0x00026a10.name: selfdiag_dma_tx_complete
0x00026a10.comment: DMA transmit-complete handler: acks DM04ITST/stops DM3/DM4, and continues building/sending the SSM response (FUN_00026814 or FUN_00025d10), computing checksum and re-arming the DMA transfer (RAM 0x800440-444) for the next chunk.

0x00026b88.name: read_ram_byte_guarded
0x00026b88.comment: Reads the byte at *param_1 for a diagnostic read, returning 0xFF if the address is outside the RAM window 0x804000-0x805fff.

0x00026ba8.name: port_sample_inhibitor_a
0x00026ba8.comment: Samples hardware ports: DAT_00804f08 = CONCAT11(P4DATA,P0DATA) (16-bit port image feeding the inhibitor/range read), DAT_00804f20 = P1DATA, etc.

0x00026c08.name: port_sample_inhibitor_b
0x00026c08.comment: Alternate sampler: DAT_00804f08 = CONCAT11(P4DATA,P0DATA); increments debounce counter DAT_00804f38.

0x00026c4c.name: latch_debounced_p0p4
0x00026c4c.comment: Latches the debounced P4/P0 port value 0x804f08 into 0x804f0c and replicates into history 0x804f18/1c.

0x00026c70.name: copy_word_pair
0x00026c70.comment: Copies param_1 into param_2[0] and param_2[1] (fills a two-slot debounce history).

0x00026c78.name: sample_port_inputs_wrap
0x00026c78.comment: Thin wrapper calling FUN_00026c08 (port input sampling).

0x00026c84.name: sample_p1_shift_switches
0x00026c84.comment: 9-state sequencer sampling P1DATA (shift/mode switches) into history 0x804f20/f28: each step reads P1DATA, updates debounce bits from P1DATA bit5, drives output strobes on RAM 0x800703 low nibble, and after step 9 latches result via FUN_00027040; returns the current step.

0x00027040.name: latch_p1_debounced
0x00027040.comment: Latches debounced P1 value 0x804f20 into 0x804f24 and replicates into history 0x804f30/34 via FUN_00027064.

0x00027064.name: copy_word_pair_2
0x00027064.comment: Copies param_1 into param_2[0] and param_2[1] (two-slot history fill); duplicate of FUN_00026c70.

0x0002706c.name: call_FUN_00026c84
0x0002706c.comment: Thin wrapper that just calls FUN_00026c84.

0x00027078.name: load_speed_timeout_cals
0x00027078.comment: Copies cal constants DAT_0001cc13/cc14 into RAM thresholds DAT_00804eb4/00804ecc (zero-speed timeout counts for the two pulse channels).

0x00027094.name: pulse_speed_calc_ch1
0x00027094.comment: In a critical section (FUN_0005f45c/0005f450) reads capture count DAT_00804ebc and edge time DAT_00804eb8; computes speed DAT_00804ec0 = -(prev-time)/count, or zeroes it after DAT_00804eb4 idle ticks. Manages direction flags DAT_00804e5e/5f.

0x00027144.name: pulse_speed_calc_ch2
0x00027144.comment: Identical period/speed calc for second pulse channel: capture DAT_00804ed4, time DAT_00804ed0, result DAT_00804ed8, idle threshold DAT_00804ecc, flags bit3 of DAT_00804e5e/5f.

0x000271f4.name: pulse_speed_calc_both
0x000271f4.comment: Runs both pulse-speed calculators FUN_00027094 and FUN_00027144.

0x00027204.name: diag_scheduler_tick
0x00027204.comment: Advances scheduler counters DAT_008052ec (mod 10) and DAT_008052ed; every 0x40 ticks runs DTC counters FUN_00027260, FUN_000273a0, FUN_00027360.

0x00027260.name: dtc_count_active_stored
0x00027260.comment: Counts set bits across 12 DTC status bytes (&PTR_DAT_0001d710) masked by enable table &DAT_0001d764; stores active count (cap 0xff) at DAT_008052d8 and stored/confirmed count (cap 0x7f) at DAT_008052d5/d9, sets MIL bit 0x80 if DAT_008052d4.

0x00027360.name: dtc_aging_accumulate
0x00027360.comment: When no test-mode/inhibit flags set and DAT_008052d4, adds drive-cycle time DAT_00804816 to 32-bit aging counter DAT_008041d0, saturating at 0xffffffff.

0x000273a0.name: dtc_freeze_frame_scan
0x000273a0.comment: If no freeze-frame stored (DAT_008041d8==0), scans 12 DTC status bytes for a newly-set fault and captures it via FUN_000273fc + FUN_0002744c.

0x000273fc.name: dtc_lookup_pcode
0x000273fc.comment: Finds first set bit in the DTC status byte and looks up its P-code from table &DAT_0001d770, storing to DAT_008052c2.

0x0002744c.name: dtc_store_freeze_frame
0x0002744c.comment: Stores captured DTC into freeze-frame block: code DAT_008041d8, range DAT_008049bd, RPM (DAT_008047c6<<2 clamped) DAT_008041da, drive-cycle DAT_008041dd.

0x00027480.name: kline_ssm_response_sm
0x00027480.comment: Main K-line/ISO-14230 (SSM) service state machine on DAT_008052eb; dispatches service subfunctions 0x7e/0xc2/0x41..0x49 to handlers (FUN_00027e90/0002801c/00028164/00028324/0002856c/000286f8) and builds negative/positive responses; guarded by FUN_0005f45c/0005f450.

0x00027898.name: kline_build_neg_response
0x00027898.comment: Builds ISO-14230 negative-response frame (0x83 0xf1 0x18 0x7f) with service echo param_1 and NRC param_2 into buffer 0x8052dd, appends checksum FUN_00027a14, sets pending-tx flag.

0x00027900.name: kline_build_neg_response_alt
0x00027900.comment: Variant of the negative-response builder that reuses byte DAT_008052df as the service echo; same buffer 0x8052dd and checksum flow.

0x00027968.name: kline_start_tx
0x00027968.comment: Loads the SCI0 mailbox regs at 0x800101/0x110/0x116/0x112 with byte param_1 and sets state DAT_008052eb=param_2 to begin transmit; resets to idle on error states.

0x000279e0.name: single_bit_mask
0x000279e0.comment: Returns param_2 masked to a single bit selected by param_1 (bit position, folded mod 0x20); used to validate requested localId bit.

0x00027a14.name: kline_checksum
0x00027a14.comment: Sums the first (param_1-1) bytes of the K-line frame buffer &DAT_008052dd, returning the 8-bit checksum.

0x00027a54.name: kline_reset_partial
0x00027a54.comment: Resets K-line message state to service 0x04 (idle-listen): clears counters DAT_008052c8/e8/ea/e9/dc and returns to receive state.

0x00027a94.name: kline_reset_full
0x00027a94.comment: Full K-line/SCI reset: masks SI03EN/S0TCNT, clears S0RCNT, zeroes 11-byte frame buffer 0x8052dd and all comm counters/flags, returns to state 0.

0x00027b5c.name: kline_inc_idle_timer
0x00027b5c.comment: In a critical section increments K-line inter-byte idle counter DAT_008052c8 (saturating at 0xff).

0x00027b80.name: kline_ssm_rx_handler
0x00027b80.comment: SCI0 receive handler: reads S0RXB into DAT_008051c5, validates ISO-14230 header bytes (0x18/0x33,0xf1,0x81) and checksum per state DAT_008052eb, advances the receive FSM or resets on framing error.

0x00027dcc.name: kline_tx_state_advance
0x00027dcc.comment: On SCI0 tx-empty, advances K-line FSM DAT_008052eb (idle->1, 3->2, 7->6/5) based on frames-sent vs frames-queued counters; clears idle timer on transition.

0x00027e90.name: ssm_read_dtc_count
0x00027e90.comment: Service 0x7e subfunction: validates localId, returns DTC/status counts (DAT_008052d5 stored count, aging counter DAT_008041d0 bytes) into the response buffer with checksum.

0x0002801c.name: ssm_read_freeze_frame
0x0002801c.comment: Service 0xc2 subfunction: returns freeze-frame fields (code DAT_008041d8, RPM DAT_008041da, range DAT_008041dc, drive-cycle DAT_008041dd) selected by localId param.

0x00028164.name: ssm_read_stored_dtcs
0x00028164.comment: Reads stored (confirmed) DTCs: walks the 12 status bytes masked by enable table, packs up to 3 P-codes from &DAT_0001d770 into the response, decrements pending count DAT_008052d6 by 3.

0x00028324.name: ssm_clear_dtcs
0x00028324.comment: Clear-DTC service: sets flag DAT_008052b3|0x40 (request clear), builds positive response with checksum.

0x00028364.name: dtc_block_clear
0x00028364.comment: Zeroes the entire DTC status block 0x8041e0-0x80421b (all 60 status/counter bytes).

0x0002856c.name: ssm_read_all_dtcs
0x0002856c.comment: Reads all pending+active DTCs (status bytes OR'd) masked by enable table, packing up to 3 P-codes from &DAT_0001d770 into the response with checksum.

0x000286f8.name: ssm_read_ecu_id
0x000286f8.comment: Service 0x49 ECU-identification: returns ROM ID/checksum bytes (from DAT_00008008.. and computed DAT_008041d4/d6) selected by index DAT_008052e1, appends checksum.

0x00028940.name: rom_checksum_compute
0x00028940.comment: Computes 16-bit additive checksum over flash 0x8024-0xfffc then 0x10000-0x5fffc, toggling the watchdog LED (FUN_00028ae0) each word; stores results to DAT_008052c6/008041d4/008041d6.

0x00028ae0.name: watchdog_led_kick
0x00028ae0.comment: Every 1000 counts of TMS0CT toggles P7DATA bit 0x10 (watchdog/heartbeat LED) and resets the timer.

0x00028b08.name: flash_reprogram_tx_sm
0x00028b08.comment: K-line flash-reprogram transmit state machine (state DAT_00805370): builds seed/ack frames into 0x805374, streams them out S0TXB, handles 5s/30s timeouts, and jumps to loader SUB_00806000 on the flash-erase command; guarded by FUN_0005f45c/0005f450.

0x00028da8.name: flash_reprogram_rx
0x00028da8.comment: Flash-reprogram SCI0 receive handler: reassembles header at 0x80537c, extracts 32-bit dest address/length (DAT_0080538c/00805394) and writes downloaded bytes to flash RAM, maintaining running checksum DAT_00805371.

0x00028f80.name: get_adc_status_byte
0x00028f80.comment: Returns A/D conversion status/flag byte DAT_00804c38.

0x00028f88.name: get_adc_channel
0x00028f88.comment: Returns the raw 10-bit A/D result for channel param_1 (<0x10) from array &DAT_00804c18, else 0.

0x00028fb4.name: build_status_snapshot
0x00028fb4.comment: Assembles a status/telemetry snapshot into the 0x8054xx block: scales pressures DAT_0080531e/00805320>>8, computes speed DAT_00804fac = DAT_008044d2*1000/0xc4 (+/0x32), and packs many input-bit flags from DAT_00804991/00805508/00805590/00805644 etc; calls FUN_00029fc0/00029f88/00029fa4.

0x00029238.name: can_rx_dispatch
0x00029238.comment: Iterates 16 CAN mailboxes (id table DAT_00804c8a, flags DAT_00804c69); for each received frame decodes payload DAT_00804cba+ by CAN id (0x410 engine RPM, 0x411/0x412 throttle, 0x511-0x515, 0x520, 0x600, 0x740/0x741) into signal RAM, or applies fail-safe FUN_00029b90 on message-timeout DAT_0080549d.

0x00029824.name: can_tx_build
0x00029824.comment: For each mailbox flagged for transmit (DAT_00804c69&0x80), packs the outgoing payload DAT_00804cba+ for CAN ids 0x420/0x421/0x422/0x723 from internal signals, then marks the frame ready.

0x00029a30.name: can410_reset
0x00029a30.comment: Resets CAN id-0x410 (engine) decoded signals to inactive defaults (DAT_008049a9=0xff, DAT_008047c6=0 RPM, etc).

0x00029a54.name: can411_reset
0x00029a54.comment: Resets CAN id-0x411 decoded signals to zero.

0x00029a88.name: can412_reset
0x00029a88.comment: Resets CAN id-0x412 decoded signals to zero.

0x00029aac.name: can511_reset
0x00029aac.comment: Resets CAN id-0x511 decoded signals (DAT_00804d3a..d3f) to zero.

0x00029ad0.name: can512_reset
0x00029ad0.comment: Resets CAN id-0x512 decoded signals (DAT_00804991=0xf0, DAT_00804d54/d4a/491a) to defaults.

0x00029af4.name: can513_reset
0x00029af4.comment: Resets CAN id-0x513 decoded signals (DAT_00804d40..d46) to zero.

0x00029b18.name: can514_reset
0x00029b18.comment: Resets CAN id-0x514 decoded signals to defaults (DAT_00804d49=0xf0).

0x00029b44.name: can515_reset
0x00029b44.comment: Resets CAN id-0x515 signal DAT_008049b4 to 5.

0x00029b50.name: can520_reset
0x00029b50.comment: Resets CAN id-0x520 decoded signals to zero.

0x00029b74.name: can600_reset
0x00029b74.comment: Resets CAN id-0x600 decoded signals to defaults (DAT_008049bd=0x28).

0x00029b90.name: can_reset_all_signals
0x00029b90.comment: Calls all per-message reset helpers (FUN_00029a30..00029b74) to clear every decoded CAN signal.

0x00029bc0.name: can410_failsafe
0x00029bc0.comment: Sets CAN id-0x410 signals to fail-safe values (DAT_008047c6=0x131 default RPM, DAT_00805367=0x40).

0x00029be4.name: can411_failsafe
0x00029be4.comment: Sets CAN id-0x411 signals to fail-safe values (DAT_008049aa/ad=0x40).

0x00029c18.name: can412_failsafe
0x00029c18.comment: Sets CAN id-0x412 signals to fail-safe values (DAT_008047ba/bc=4000, DAT_0080498e/00804990=0x40).

0x00029c3c.name: can511_failsafe
0x00029c3c.comment: Sets CAN id-0x511 signals (DAT_00804d3a..d3f) to zero fail-safe.

0x00029c60.name: can512_failsafe
0x00029c60.comment: Sets CAN id-0x512 signals to fail-safe (DAT_00804991=0xf0).

0x00029c7c.name: can513_failsafe
0x00029c7c.comment: Sets CAN id-0x513 signals to zero fail-safe.

0x00029ca0.name: can514_failsafe
0x00029ca0.comment: Sets CAN id-0x514 signals to fail-safe (DAT_00804d49=0xf0, low nibble of DAT_0080491e kept).

0x00029cd0.name: can515_failsafe
0x00029cd0.comment: Sets CAN id-0x515 signal DAT_008049b4 to 5.

0x00029cdc.name: can520_failsafe
0x00029cdc.comment: Sets CAN id-0x520 signals to fail-safe (low nibble of DAT_008049b5 kept, rest zero).

0x00029d04.name: can600_failsafe
0x00029d04.comment: Sets CAN id-0x600 signals to fail-safe (DAT_008049bd=0x28, DAT_00804d4b=0xff).

0x00029d18.name: can_apply_failsafe_defaults
0x00029d18.comment: When ignition/comm-fault bit DAT_0080411c&0x80 set, builds a per-message fault mask from DAT_00804929 and DAT_008049c9-d2 using ROM weight table 0x1d830.., then calls the matching per-message fail-safe setters (FUN_00029bc0..00029d04).

0x00029f88.name: get_clamped_804ea0
0x00029f88.comment: Returns DAT_00804ea0 clamped to 16-bit max 0xffff (a speed/frequency value).

0x00029fc0.name: get_clamped_804e8c
0x00029fc0.comment: Returns DAT_00804e8c clamped to 16-bit max 0xffff (turbine/input speed).

0x00029ff8.name: flag_from_8049b2
0x00029ff8.comment: Sets/clears bit 8 of status byte DAT_00804eef from DAT_008049b2 nonzero.

0x0002a048.name: flag_from_805674_b1
0x0002a048.comment: Sets/clears bit 0x40 of DAT_00804eef from DAT_00805674 bit1.

0x0002a09c.name: flag_from_805590_b0
0x0002a09c.comment: Sets/clears bit 0x80 of DAT_00804eef from DAT_00805590 bit0.

0x0002a0f4.name: flag_from_805590_b1
0x0002a0f4.comment: Sets/clears bit 2 of DAT_00804eee from DAT_00805590 bit1.

0x0002a148.name: flag_from_805590_b2
0x0002a148.comment: Sets/clears bit 8 of DAT_00804ef0 from DAT_00805590 bit2.

0x0002a19c.name: flag_from_8050e4
0x0002a19c.comment: Sets/clears bit 2 of DAT_00804eef from DAT_008050e4 nonzero.

0x0002a1ec.name: stage_sol1_duty
0x0002a1ec.comment: Copies computed solenoid-1 duty/pressure DAT_0080505a to output DAT_00804ef4.

0x0002a1f8.name: stage_sol2_duty
0x0002a1f8.comment: Copies computed solenoid-2 value DAT_0080505c to output DAT_00804ef2.

0x0002a204.name: stage_sol3_duty
0x0002a204.comment: Copies computed solenoid-3 value DAT_0080505e to output DAT_00804ef6.

0x0002a210.name: stage_sol4_duty
0x0002a210.comment: Copies computed solenoid-4 value DAT_00805060 to output DAT_00804ef8.

0x0002a21c.name: stage_sol5_duty
0x0002a21c.comment: Copies computed solenoid-5 value DAT_00805062 to output DAT_00804efa.

0x0002a228.name: stage_sol6_duty
0x0002a228.comment: Copies computed solenoid-6 value DAT_00805064 to output DAT_00804efc.

0x0002a234.name: stage_sol7_duty
0x0002a234.comment: Copies computed solenoid-7 value DAT_00805066 to output DAT_00804efe.

0x0002a240.name: inhibitor_raw_port_read
0x0002a240.comment: Reads P0DATA bits 4-7 (0x80/0x40/0x20/0x10) and P4DATA bit 4 (0x1000) from the port image DAT_00804f18, packs them into a 5-bit value (bit0=P0.7, bit1=P0.6, bit2=P0.5, bit3=P0.4, bit4=P4.4=SW3 monitor). Returned value becomes DAT_008047ec, then XOR 0x1F -> mask 0x1F -> DAT_008047f2 (inhibitor switch state; bit=1 => switch grounded).

0x0002a2fc.name: pack_port_f30_bits
0x0002a2fc.comment: Packs selected bits of 16-bit port DAT_00804f30 (>>8 &0x78 plus bit6->0x80, bit3->0x02) into a status byte.

0x0002a344.name: test_f30_bit7
0x0002a344.comment: Returns true if DAT_00804f30 bit 0x80 is set.

0x0002a380.name: ssm_build_response
0x0002a380.comment: Anchor: fills SSM staging buffer 0x805271+ with each parameter's live source (A/D bytes, pressures scaled /100, solenoid currents *255/400, gear DAT_0080488e, ATF temp DAT_00804813/25 raw-5, plus decode helpers FUN_0002a85c..0002af44).

0x0002a870.name: ssm_pack_flags_54fc
0x0002a870.comment: Packs an SSM status byte from bits of DAT_008054fc, DAT_008049ac, DAT_00805508, DAT_00805688 (switch/relay states).

0x0002a900.name: enum_to_gear2
0x0002a900.comment: Maps selector position enum DAT_008047f5 to a small code: enum 0x08 -> 4, enum 0x02 -> 2, else 0. ?

0x0002a93c.name: ssm_pack_awd_flags
0x0002a93c.comment: Builds an SSM status byte from AWD/duty flags DAT_00010000 and DAT_00804999 bits plus DAT_00805674 bit1.

0x0002a9cc.name: range_signal_build
0x0002a9cc.comment: Builds a range-signal SSM byte: bit0x80 from DAT_00804992&2, bit0x20 set when position enum DAT_008047f5==0x01 (Park/P Range), bit0x08 from DAT_00805590&2, bit0x01 when enum==0x04. Feeds the P/N/R/D range-signal SSM items.

0x0002aa34.name: inhibitor_sw_decode_ssm_d4
0x0002aa34.comment: Builds SSM 0xD4 inhibitor byte from DAT_008047f2: bit0x40 set if SW1(bit0)=open, 0x20 SW2(bit1), 0x10 SW3(bit2), 0x08 SW4(bit3), 0x04 SW3-monitor(bit4); bit0x02 from DAT_00805590&4. Bit set = switch OPEN. Unwired reads 0x78.

0x0002aacc.name: fluid_pressure_sw_decode_ssm_d5

0x0003db1c.name: pressure_switch_gear_estimate

0x0003dee8.name: variable_init_powerup

0x0003e5c8.name: throttle_accel_update

0x0003e5dc.name: shift_learn_reset

0x0003e66c.name: shift_learn_enable_gate

0x0003e7dc.name: shift_learn_idle_timer

0x0003e9ec.name: shift_learn_sample_counter
0x0003e9ec.comment: While learn active (DAT_008055a8 bit0 clear), samples FUN_00055070 speed into _DAT_008046ea and increments sample counter DAT_008046b0 under speed/state gating; resets on abort.

0x0003ed24.name: shift_learn_store

0x0003edf4.name: shift_learn_lookup_by_type

0x0003eed0.name: shift_time_limit_check
0x0003eed0.comment: Loads per-gear shift-time limit DAT_00804ad2 from table 0x13510 and, if measured DAT_00804ad0 exceeds it (with status gating), sets abort bit DAT_008055a8 bit3.

0x0003ef3c.comment: Loads per-gear speed-delta limit DAT_00804ad6 from table 0x13512 and, if DAT_00804ad4 exceeds it, sets DAT_008055a8 bit0x10.

0x0003ef84.name: shift_learn_ratio_calc

0x0003f0a8.comment: While shifting (DAT_0080487e==1) accumulates turbine speed DAT_00804618 += DAT_008044d2, else resets it to 0.

0x0003f0d4.name: shift_learn_store_indexed

0x0003f42c.name: shift_learn_valid_read
0x0003f42c.comment: Reads per-gear learn cell via FUN_0003f4c8 into DAT_008046d0 only when the gear's valid bit in DAT_0080492f is set, else 0.

0x0003f4c8.comment: Returns (short)(&DAT_008041aa)[DAT_0080487f] — the per-gear stored shift-learn cell.

0x0003f4dc.name: shift_learn_timers

0x0003f664.name: shift_learn_measure_init

0x000405e8.name: shift_enable_temp_table

0x000411d0.name: gear_shift_state_machine

0x0004a1b0.comment: Returns a shift status/reason code (3/4/6/0xd or FUN_0004a23c detail) from limp flag DAT_00805504, lockup DAT_00804852 bit1, DAT_008054fc bit6, and DAT_008055f8.

0x0004a23c.name: compute_shift_reason_detail
0x0004a23c.comment: Returns detailed shift reason code from control mode DAT_00804b5c and status bits DAT_00805570/56bc/805504/8030/804852 (values 0,1,5,8,0xb,0xc).

0x0004a2ec.name: compute_shift_status_code_b
0x0004a2ec.comment: Variant of FUN_0004a1b0 returning shift status code (3/4/6/0xd or FUN_0004a23c detail) from DAT_00805504, DAT_00804852 bit1, and DAT_008054fc bit6.

0x0004a368.name: lockup_mode_select_b
0x0004a368.comment: Variant of the L/U mode selector: reads DAT_00804852/DAT_00805504/DAT_008054fc bits and returns mode code (3,6,0xd or FUN_0004a23c). Used when a different condition path applies.

0x0004a3d8.name: lockup_slip_hysteresis_update
0x0004a3d8.comment: Decrements timer DAT_00804841, applies ATF-temp hysteresis (DAT_00804825 vs cal DAT_0001018d..90) to DAT_008054f8 bit0, toggles L/U request bit 0x80 of DAT_00805504 based on gear(DAT_0080488e==4), throttle(DAT_00804816) and flags, and sets/clears DAT_00804852 bit 0x40.

0x0004a6a4.name: lockup_engage_debounce
0x0004a6a4.comment: Debounce for a lockup/pressure condition: compares DAT_00804d4b against cal thresholds (DAT_00008484/86/88/83), ramps counter DAT_008043a0, and sets/clears DAT_008043a2 bits 1 and 2.

0x0004a77c.name: atf_temp_threshold_flag
0x0004a77c.comment: ATF temperature (DAT_00804813) hysteresis against cal DAT_00010162/63; sets/clears DAT_008043a3 bit0.

0x0004a7b8.name: lockup_slip_control_state
0x0004a7b8.comment: Torque-converter slip/lockup control state machine keyed on shift lever(DAT_00804842) and DAT_00805574 bit tests; loads timer DAT_0080484f from cal DAT_0000845d and sets L/U control bits (0x08/0x10/0x02/0x04) in DAT_00805504.

0x0004aa14.name: lockup_apply_supervisor
0x0004aa14.comment: Lockup apply supervisor: calls FUN_0004abc4/FUN_0004ac24, then sets/clears DAT_00805504 bit 0x40 (L/U enable) from a wide gate of fault/enable flags (DAT_00804120, DAT_008043a3/a2, cal DAT_00010169, DAT_0001189a, DAT_00805510), then calls FUN_0004aabc.

0x0004aabc.name: lockup_slip_dispatch
0x0004aabc.comment: If solenoid-pattern state DAT_008047f3 is -0x80/-0x7b (drive ranges), runs slip sub-controllers FUN_0004aaf0 and FUN_0004ab8c; otherwise clears L/U slip bit 0x20 of DAT_00805504.

0x0004aaf0.name: lockup_slip_engage_gate
0x0004aaf0.comment: Computes slip-control target via FUN_0004aca8 then gates L/U slip bit 0x20 of DAT_00805504 on cal/flag conditions (DAT_0001189a, DAT_0080557c, DAT_00804992, DAT_00805510, DAT_0001019e, DAT_00804878) and threshold DAT_00804847 vs DAT_0080480f.

0x0004ab8c.name: lockup_slip_release_check
0x0004ab8c.comment: If slip error DAT_008047e8 below DAT_00804851 and DAT_00804846<=DAT_00804845, clears L/U slip bit 0x20 (DAT_00805504) and bit0 of DAT_0080550c.

0x0004abc4.name: lockup_slip_target_lookup
0x0004abc4.comment: Looks up two slip targets from throttle DAT_00804816 via table-interp FUN_000454e4 (cal &DAT_000101c4/&DAT_000101d6) into DAT_00804846/DAT_00804851; increments settle counter DAT_00804845 while slip bit 0x20 set.

0x0004ac24.name: lockup_slip_error_scale
0x0004ac24.comment: Decrements timer DAT_00804844, reloads it from cal DAT_00008462 when DAT_0080480f exceeds thresholds, sets/clears DAT_00805520 bit0, and when clear stores scaled slip DAT_008047e8>>6 to DAT_0080481b.

0x0004aca8.name: lockup_slip_duty_lookup
0x0004aca8.comment: Computes L/U slip duty DAT_00804847 via 2-D lookup FUN_00045690(DAT_0080481b, throttle DAT_00804816, cal &DAT_000101a0).

0x0004acd0.name: lockup_slip_learn_control
0x0004acd0.comment: Large L/U slip/lockup learn state machine: uses turbine/output speed regs DAT_0080535c/DAT_00805310, slip DAT_00805300, ramps counters DAT_0080439c/9e, and sets DAT_00805504 bit0 (L/U apply) plus DAT_008056d8/DAT_0080536c control bits per solenoid-pattern DAT_008047f3 and flag gates.

0x0004b288.name: atf_temp_flag_1140a
0x0004b288.comment: ATF temp (DAT_00804813) hysteresis vs cal DAT_0001140a/0b; sets/clears DAT_008056bc bit1.

0x0004b2c4.name: neutral_idle_state_flags
0x0004b2c4.comment: Sets DAT_00804852 bits 0x01/0x08 from neutral-control enable DAT_00804992 and solenoid-pattern DAT_00804878; latches DAT_0080536c bit2 on rising edge of DAT_00804992, saves prior state to DAT_0080536d.

0x0004b36c.name: lockup_off_timer
0x0004b36c.comment: On L/U release edge (DAT_00805351 bit3 set, DAT_00805510 bit3 clear) latches DAT_00805350 bit0; ramps counter DAT_0080534e while set and DAT_0080487e==0, clears bit0 when past cal DAT_00010166; snapshots DAT_00805510 to DAT_00805351.

0x0004b3f8.name: lockup_enable_gate
0x0004b3f8.comment: Gates L/U enable bit 0x40 of DAT_008054fc on a wide condition set (cal DAT_0001189a, sensor/flag DAT_00804991/8d, DAT_00804120/11c/118 bit tests, DAT_00804961) excluding non-drive solenoid patterns DAT_008047f3.

0x0004b49c.name: gear_shift_permit_check
0x0004b49c.comment: Builds local gear-remap table {5,3,2,1,0,4} indexed by DAT_008047f3&7; sets/clears shift-permit bit2 of DAT_0080485f based on DAT_008052f7, L/U flag, DAT_00804d57 bits, DAT_0080411c, gear DAT_0080488e and lever DAT_00804842.

0x0004b56c.name: select_gear_pattern
0x0004b56c.comment: Picks target solenoid-pattern DAT_0080485d: defaults to DAT_008047f3, but when pattern is -0x80 and shift-permit bit set calls FUN_0004b5b8 for remap.

0x0004b5b8.name: gear_pattern_remap_lookup
0x0004b5b8.comment: Indexes ROM pattern table at 0x1016e by gear DAT_0080488e*4 + adjusted DAT_008052f7 to remap the commanded solenoid pattern; falls back to DAT_008047f3 when entry==-1.

0x0004b608.name: shift_schedule_index
0x0004b608.comment: Maps solenoid-pattern DAT_0080485d and shift-mode DAT_0080485a to indices, computes DAT_00804bcc = mode*0x32 + range*10 + DAT_0080487a*2, and loads shift-schedule pointers DAT_00804a0c/a10 from PTR tables at 0x17e20/0x17e24.

0x0004b748.name: shift_schedule_ptr_override
0x0004b748.comment: Selects up/down shift-schedule curve pointers DAT_00804a0c/a10 (ROM 0x17d9e/0x17d94/0x17e14) based on manual-mode DAT_0080498d, DAT_008043a3, DAT_0080552c/28/34 bit tests, and speed DAT_00805353 vs DAT_0080485e; ramps counter DAT_0080459c.

0x0004b880.name: gear_shift_decision
0x0004b880.comment: Compares vehicle-speed threshold DAT_00804899 against up/down schedule curves (FUN_00045320 with DAT_00804a0c/a10 and throttle DAT_00804826) to raise/lower target gear DAT_0080485e; after settle counter DAT_00804854 latches DAT_00804842/43/50 (lever/mode) and sets shift-request bit4 of DAT_0080485f.

0x0004b9b8.name: shift_scheduler_dispatch
0x0004b9b8.comment: Top-level shift scheduler tick: calls solenoid-pattern latch FUN_00052818 then lockup/slip and gear-decision subfunctions (FUN_0004acd0, 0004a7b8, 0004aa14, 0004a3d8, 0004a6a4, 0004a77c, 0004b288, 0004b36c, 0004b3f8, 0004a0bc, 0004b49c, 0004b56c, 0004b608, 0004b748, 0004b880).

0x0004ba00.name: copy_solenoid_status_block
0x0004ba00.comment: Copies 7-byte block DAT_00805080..86 (raw solenoid/status data) to DAT_0080494c..52.

0x0004ba3c.name: ssm_flag_range9_update
0x0004ba3c.comment: Sets/clears DAT_00805590 bit2 when inhibitor range nibble (DAT_008047f2&0xf)==9 and not in fail mode (DAT_00805640 bit0); calls FUN_0002a148 to publish the SSM flag.

0x0004ba98.name: pressure_temp_compensate
0x0004ba98.comment: Applies temperature/gear correction to a 16-bit pressure command: interpolates ROM breakpoint table near 0x15bc8..0x15c68 by ATF temp DAT_00804813, applies gain/offset per gear DAT_00804875 and clamps to 0..0x7fff/0xffff; extra scale via table 0x15c72 unless override DAT_00804256 set.

0x0004bcc0.name: awd_transfer_duty_control
0x0004bcc0.comment: Computes AWD/transfer-clutch engagement request: derives DAT_00804954 from torque DAT_00804f98 (÷cal DAT_0001191e), hysteresis vs cal DAT_00011920/21, and sets DAT_00805674 bit1 (AWD lock) per range DAT_008047f2 and flags; publishes via FUN_0002a048.

0x0004bea8.name: turbine_ratio_calc
0x0004bea8.comment: Filters engine/turbine torque DAT_008042be toward DAT_00804b00 (gain DAT_0000806d) into DAT_00804afe, computes speed ratio DAT_008042d8 = (DAT_008042d0<<10)/DAT_00804afe; else loads gear-indexed defaults from ROM 0x129b4/0x12fc6/0x12fc8.

0x0004bfbc.name: torque_ratio_avg_shift
0x0004bfbc.comment: Rolling average of speed-ratio: iVar1=((count-1)*DAT_008042da+DAT_008042d8)/count (count=DAT_00008042), clamps to 0..0xffff, then shifts history DAT_008042da..e2.

0x0004c028.name: load_gear_pressure_cal
0x0004c028.comment: Loads per-gear (DAT_0080487a) line-pressure cal constants from ROM table 0xf1ac (stride 0xc) into DAT_008048b2/b3, DAT_00804574/76/78, and DAT_0080457a.

0x0004c068.name: line_pressure_ramp_timer
0x0004c068.comment: Line-pressure ramp counter DAT_008048b4 keyed on solenoid-pattern DAT_008047f3/DAT_008048b5: resets/holds 0xff in non-drive, ramps toward gear limits DAT_008048b2/b3 in drive; sets DAT_00805608 bit3 and saves prior pattern to DAT_008048b5.

0x0004c198.name: line_pressure_blend
0x0004c198.comment: Blends line-pressure command DAT_0080457c/DAT_0080457e per gear DAT_0080487a using cal DAT_00804574/76/578/57a and turbine torque DAT_008046fe, clamped to 0xffff; uses ramp DAT_008048b4 vs limits DAT_008048b2/b3, defaults DAT_00804704/00.

0x0004c350.name: line_pressure_dispatch
0x0004c350.comment: Line-pressure control tick: calls FUN_0004c028 (load cal), FUN_0004c068 (ramp timer), FUN_0004c198 (blend).

0x0004c364.name: accum_backpressure_state
0x0004c364.comment: Accumulator/back-pressure control state machine DAT_008048a8: transitions on DAT_00804883, DAT_00805608 bit0, timer DAT_0080453e; computes an index from speed cals DAT_00008700/02/04/06 and torque estimate, indexes ROM table at 0x1c3de for next state.

0x0004c570.name: accum_state_timer
0x0004c570.comment: Ramps timer DAT_00804540 while accumulator state DAT_008048a8 nonzero, resets when zero.

0x0004c59c.name: accum_state_timer2
0x0004c59c.comment: Ramps secondary timer DAT_0080459a once DAT_00804540 exceeds cal DAT_00008700; resets otherwise.

0x0004c5d0.name: accum_pressure_integrate
0x0004c5d0.comment: Integrates accumulator back-pressure DAT_0080453e per state DAT_008048a8 using base FUN_0004c944 and cal deltas (DAT_0000870a..14) plus temp trim FUN_0003edf4(0xfe,4), clamped 0..0xffff.

0x0004c944.name: accum_base_pressure_calc
0x0004c944.comment: Computes base accumulator pressure from clamped input pressure param_1 (limits DAT_00008724/26) and clamped ATF temp param_2 (limits DAT_00008728/29): (P*cal871c - T*cal871e)*10>>8 + cal8720, clamped to cal8722.

0x0004ca3c.name: accum_control_dispatch
0x0004ca3c.comment: Accumulator back-pressure control tick: calls FUN_0004c364 (state), FUN_0004c570/59c (timers), FUN_0004c5d0 (integrate).

0x0004ca54.name: shift_quality_counters
0x0004ca54.comment: Diagnostic shift-count accumulator: classifies slip error DAT_008047e8 into band DAT_00804949 (cal DAT_00015035/36), then increments the appropriate per-gear/per-direction lifetime counter in the DAT_008040d4..0x8040e block; saves prior direction DAT_0080494a.

0x0004ce2c.name: clutch_learn_reset
0x0004ce2c.comment: Resets a large block of clutch-learn/shift-timing RAM state (DAT_00804870/74-77, DAT_008044xx pressure vars, DAT_00805528/34/50/54/58/5c control bits, DAT_008048a9/be etc.) at start of a shift.

0x0004d048.name: clutch_pressure_snapshot_04
0x0004d048.comment: Snapshots current turbine torque DAT_000086c2 to DAT_008043b4 and computes learned pressure DAT_008044da via FUN_00033a28(...,4); sets DAT_008048bd bit 0x40. Shift-phase pressure capture.

0x0004d074.name: clutch_pressure_snapshot_02
0x0004d074.comment: Captures on-coming/off-going clutch pressures: DAT_008043a4/DAT_008044de from DAT_000086c2 (mask 0x10) and DAT_00804486/DAT_0080440a from DAT_000086c4 (mask 0x40) via FUN_00033a28; sets DAT_008048bd bit1.

0x0004d0b8.name: clutch_pressure_snapshot_04b
0x0004d0b8.comment: Shift-phase pressure capture: shifts prior DAT_00804486/0080440a into DAT_00804484/00804408, stores DAT_000086c2/c4 derived pressures (masks 0x10/0x20) and sets DAT_008048bd=4.

0x0004d104.name: clutch_pressure_snapshot_08
0x0004d104.comment: Shift-phase pressure capture: rotates DAT_00804486->DAT_00804484, stores DAT_000086c2 (mask0x10) and DAT_000086c4 (mask0x40) pressures, sets DAT_008048bd bit3.

0x0004d158.name: clutch_pressure_snapshot_10
0x0004d158.comment: Shift-phase pressure capture: stores DAT_000086c2 (mask0x10) to DAT_008043a4/DAT_008044de and DAT_000086c4 (mask0x20) to DAT_00804484/00804408; sets DAT_008048bd bit4.

0x0004d19c.name: clutch_pressure_snapshot_dir
0x0004d19c.comment: Direction-dependent (up DAT_0080487e==1 vs down ==2) pressure capture: stores torque DAT_000086c2/86c4 into learn vars with masks (4/8 or 0x10/0x20/0x40) and sets corresponding DAT_008048bd bits.

0x0004d23c.name: clutch_snapshot_dispatch
0x0004d23c.comment: Looks up shift-phase code from ROM table 0x1cb10 by DAT_00804892*0xe+DAT_0080487f, then dispatches to the matching pressure-snapshot routine (FUN_0004d048/074/0b8/104/158/19c) followed by learn reset FUN_0004ce2c.

0x0004d2ec.name: shift_pattern_change_flag
0x0004d2ec.comment: Sets/clears DAT_00805568 bit1 when shift direction DAT_0080487e unchanged but pattern index DAT_0080487f changed (mid-shift pattern change).

0x0004d328.name: clutch_final_pressure_capture
0x0004d328.comment: Direction-dependent final-pressure capture via FUN_0003edf4/FUN_00033a28 into DAT_00804580..88 pairs (masks 4/8 for up, 0x10/0x20/0x40 for down).

0x0004d3c4.name: shift_transition_capture
0x0004d3c4.comment: On a shift transition (change in DAT_0080487e/8f/92) invokes snapshot dispatch FUN_0004d23c, change flag FUN_0004d2ec and final capture FUN_0004d328; also handles garage-shift complete (DAT_008048a9==2).

0x0004d410.name: shift_phase_code_up1_10
0x0004d410.comment: Sets on-coming clutch phase code DAT_0080488f to 0x10 or 0x12 based on DAT_00805528 bits 0x10/0x20. Upshift phase-1 selector.

0x0004d444.name: shift_phase_code_up1_20
0x0004d444.comment: Sets on-coming clutch phase code DAT_0080488f to 0x20 or 0x22 per DAT_00805528 bits 0x10/0x20. Upshift phase-2 selector.

0x0004d478.name: shift_phase_code_up1_30
0x0004d478.comment: Sets phase code DAT_0080488f to 0x30/0xb0/0x32 per DAT_00805528 bits and pressure compare DAT_00804474<DAT_00804512. Upshift phase-3 selector.

0x0004d4c4.name: shift_phase_code_up2_10
0x0004d4c4.comment: Sets phase code DAT_0080488f = 0x10 or 0x12 per DAT_00805528 bit 0x10. Direction-2 phase selector.

0x0004d4e4.name: shift_phase_code_up2_20
0x0004d4e4.comment: Sets phase code DAT_0080488f = 0x20 or 0x21 per DAT_00805528 bit 0x10.

0x0004d504.name: shift_phase_code_up2_30
0x0004d504.comment: Sets phase code DAT_0080488f = 0x30/0xb0/0x31 per DAT_00805528 bit 0x10 and pressure compare DAT_00804474<DAT_00804512.

0x0004d53c.name: downshift_phase_code_10
0x0004d53c.comment: Sets off-going clutch phase code DAT_00804890 (0x10/0x90/0x11/0x12/0x13) per DAT_00805528 bits and per-shift bit extracted from DAT_00805600 indexed by DAT_0080487f; pressure compare DAT_00804472<DAT_008043aa.

0x0004d5e0.name: downshift_phase_code_20
0x0004d5e0.comment: Sets DAT_00804890 to 0x20..0x23 per DAT_00805524 bit0 and DAT_00805528 bits 0x10/0x20.

0x0004d628.name: downshift_phase_code_30
0x0004d628.comment: Sets DAT_00804890 to 0x30..0x34 per DAT_00805524/28 bits and pressure compare DAT_008044f0<DAT_008044dc.

0x0004d688.name: downshift_phase_code_10b
0x0004d688.comment: Alternate downshift phase-code selector: sets DAT_00804890 (0x10/0x90/0x11/0x12) using per-shift bits from DAT_00805600/DAT_00805604 (indexed by DAT_0080487f) and DAT_00804480, gated by DAT_00805528 bit0x10 and DAT_00804472<DAT_008043aa.

0x0004d78c.name: downshift_phase_code_20b
0x0004d78c.comment: Loads threshold DAT_008044e2 from ROM table 0xb37c by DAT_0080487f, then sets DAT_00804890 to 0x20/0x21/0x22 comparing DAT_008042da<DAT_008044e2 and DAT_00805528 bit0x10.

0x0004d7dc.name: downshift_phase_code_30b
0x0004d7dc.comment: Sets DAT_00804890 to 0x30/0x31/0x32 comparing DAT_008044de<DAT_008044e0 and DAT_00805528 bit0x10.

0x0004d814.name: clear_oncoming_phase
0x0004d814.comment: Sets on-coming clutch phase code DAT_0080488f = 0 (no-shift / neutral phase).

0x0004d820.name: clear_offgoing_phase
0x0004d820.comment: Sets off-going clutch phase code DAT_00804890 = 0.

0x0004d82c.name: shift_phase_dispatch
0x0004d82c.comment: Selects on-coming (DAT_0080488f) and off-going (DAT_00804890) clutch phase codes for the active shift by dispatching on direction DAT_0080487e and phase indices DAT_00804874/75 to the FUN_0004d410..7dc phase selectors.

0x0004d9fc.name: gear_ratio_arbitration
0x0004d9fc.comment: Computes candidate gears DAT_0080487c/87b/87d from output speed vs schedule curves (FUN_00045320 with DAT_00804a38..60 and throttle DAT_00804826), then arbitrates the actual gear DAT_0080487a and range holds via DAT_00805528/34/2c/30 bit tests; sets skip-shift bit 0x40 of DAT_0080552c.

0x0004dc78.name: skip_shift_detect
0x0004dc78.comment: Detects a skip/coast shift by comparing pattern history DAT_008047f3/48b8/b9 through ROM table 0x1caa4 (5-wide) against current gear; sets/clears DAT_00805534 bit2 and skip-direction DAT_008048bc; shifts pattern/gear history.

0x0004de58.name: kickdown_torque_gate
0x0004de58.comment: Sets kickdown-permit timer DAT_008048b6 from cal DAT_00008731 when gear is 3/4 (DAT_0080487a), cal-flag DAT_00008730 set, and speed DAT_00804816 within window DAT_00008733/34 and DAT_00804899<=DAT_00008732; else decrements.

0x0004def0.name: manual_downshift_permit
0x0004def0.comment: Manual/2-1 downshift permit: on gear1 with speed DAT_00804899>=cal DAT_00008735 and kickdown timer DAT_008048b6 set, sets DAT_0080552c bit0x20 and loads timer DAT_0080458e from cal; clears the bit when speed exceeds schedule (FUN_00045320 DAT_00804a3c) or timer expires.

0x0004dfa0.name: manual_downshift_permit2
0x0004dfa0.comment: Second manual-downshift permit gated by cal DAT_00008730 bit2: manages timer DAT_00804590 and DAT_00805530 bit0 using gear1 + kickdown DAT_008048b6 and schedule compare FUN_00045320(DAT_00804a3c).

0x0004e078.name: gear_select_dispatch
0x0004e078.comment: Gear-selection/arbitration tick: calls kickdown/permit checks (FUN_0004de58/def0/dfa0), gear arbitration FUN_0004d9fc, skip-shift FUN_0004dc78, direction/pattern FUN_0004e0ac/120/728/9c8; saves prior direction to DAT_00804b02.

0x0004e0ac.name: compute_shift_direction
0x0004e0ac.comment: Compares current gear DAT_0080487a to target DAT_0080488e to set shift direction DAT_0080487e (2=down,0=none,1=up) and DAT_008048c5 bit4; loads pattern index DAT_0080487f from ROM table 0x1c254 by (target*5+current).

0x0004e120.name: shift_type_lookup
0x0004e120.comment: Maps pattern index DAT_0080487f (<0xe) through ROM table 0x1c36b to shift-type code DAT_00804893, else 0xff.

0x0004e148.name: shift_solenoid_timers
0x0004e148.comment: Manages four apply-solenoid timers DAT_00804522/24/26/28 (loaded from cal DAT_0000880c/0e/10/12) keyed on clutch states DAT_00804881/86/83/89 and DAT_00805600 request bits; sets/clears DAT_00805600 low nibble and change bits per pattern DAT_0080487f.

0x0004e454.name: lockup_slip_limit_lookup
0x0004e454.comment: Scales torque DAT_008042c2>>5 (clamp 0xff) as index into ROM curves 0xf0b0/f0ea/f124 to get L/U slip limits DAT_008048ae/af/ad; sets/clears DAT_00805528 bit2 comparing DAT_00804984 against them.

0x0004e728.name: shift_start_flag
0x0004e728.comment: On start of a shift (DAT_0080487e nonzero) with prior no-shift DAT_0080486f and speed DAT_00804813<=cal DAT_000086a6, sets DAT_00805528 bit0x10; saves prior direction to DAT_0080486f.

0x0004e770.name: lockup_slip_torque_model
0x0004e770.comment: Computes L/U/clutch torque-capacity model DAT_008044d6 from cal DAT_008044ee and engine params DAT_0000803e/8040 scaled by turbine torque DAT_008042be per pattern DAT_0080487f; sets DAT_0080552c bit3 (slip limit) and calls slip-progress FUN_0004e92c.

0x0004e92c.name: lockup_slip_progress
0x0004e92c.comment: Slip-progress counter DAT_00804895 toward limit DAT_00804894: sets/clears DAT_00805528 bit0x20 by comparing torque model DAT_008044d6 against DAT_008042d0, increments while slipping.

0x0004e9c8.name: manual_gear_hold_flag
0x0004e9c8.comment: In manual mode (DAT_00804842==4) compares commanded gear DAT_0080487a to solenoid-pattern-derived gear from DAT_008047f3 and sets/clears DAT_0080556c bit0x10 (manual mismatch); mirrors into DAT_008055d4 bit0.

0x0004ea9c.name: shift_torque_delta_flag
0x0004ea9c.comment: Tracks torque DAT_008044d2 delta since phase change DAT_00804875 (baseline DAT_00804548), clamps to short, and sets/clears DAT_0080552c bit1 comparing to cal DAT_00008716/18.

0x0004eb34.name: shift_timeout_counter
0x0004eb34.comment: Increments shift-timeout counter DAT_008048b1 (unless gear 3/4 or DAT_00805528 bit2 clear), loads per-gear limit DAT_008048b0 from ROM 0xf15e, sets/clears DAT_00805610 bit0 when counter exceeds limit.

0x0004ebc8.name: shift_abort_flag
0x0004ebc8.comment: Sets DAT_00805610 bit1 (shift abort) from timeout bit0, direction, and multiple DAT_00805644 fail-mode bit tests.

0x0004ec24.name: double_shift_tracker
0x0004ec24.comment: Tracks multi/double-shift sequences via pattern DAT_0080487f: sets DAT_00805604 bits and counter DAT_0080458a/8c, arms DAT_00805604 bit1 on pattern completion (DAT_00805600 bits); saves prior DAT_00804891/92.

0x0004ed48.name: shift_execution_dispatch

0x00050210.name: select_line_pressure_map

0x000502ec.name: clutch_apply_state_select

0x000506d4.name: apply_clutch4_state

0x0005079c.name: apply_clutch2_state
0x0005079c.comment: Resolves 2nd clutch state DAT_00804886 from ROM table 0x87d4 by pattern DAT_0080487f with hold/skip logic keyed on DAT_008048a6/a7 (prior map, prior pattern), DAT_008048c5 bit0 and solenoid-pattern DAT_008047f3.

0x000509bc.name: apply_clutch1_state
0x000509bc.comment: Resolves 1st clutch state DAT_00804881 from ROM table 0x87e2 by pattern DAT_0080487f, gated by garage-shift/direction and line-pressure ramp DAT_008048b2/b4; forces state 9 (hold) for gears 1-3 when DAT_00805608 bit3 set.

0x00050a94.name: apply_clutch3_state
0x00050a94.comment: Resolves 3rd clutch state DAT_00804883 from ROM table 0x87f0 by pattern DAT_0080487f; forces state 0xa (hold) for gears 3/4 when DAT_00805608 bit3 set.

0x00050b64.name: select_solenoid_map_code
0x00050b64.comment: Selects composite solenoid-map code DAT_0080488b: from DAT_00804885 in no-shift, else ROM table 0x87fe by pattern DAT_0080487f; mirrors DAT_00805528 bit5 into DAT_0080552c bit2.

0x00050bb0.name: release_clutch_fallback

0x00050c5c.name: clutch_state_from_torque
0x00050c5c.comment: Maps clutch-map selector param_1 (0..3) plus throttle DAT_00804826 and torque DAT_00804984 through cal windows/curves (DAT_000086b0..c0) to a clutch state (1=apply,2=release).

0x00050e18.name: clutch5_apply_detect
0x00050e18.comment: Detects 5th-clutch/high-range apply from speed DAT_00804816, torque DAT_00804984 and flags (DAT_00805508, DAT_00804144, cal 872a), sets DAT_00805608 bit0/2, returns state 2 or 3.

0x00050f14.name: clutch_apply_time_delay
0x00050f14.comment: Table-search cal 0x8740 (stride4) by torque DAT_00804984 for delay DAT_00804592, ramps counter DAT_00804596; returns 1 while counter<=delay (apply not yet timed out).

0x00050f94.name: clutch_release_time_delay

0x00051090.name: clutch_engage_hold_flag
0x00051090.comment: Sets/clears DAT_00805534 bit0x10 when a clutch is in the hold state (DAT_00804881==9 or DAT_00804883==0xa).

0x000510cc.name: manual_mode_transition

0x00051390.name: solenoid_apply_bit_hlrc

0x0005144c.name: resolve_clutch_pressures

0x00051484.name: clutch_state_to_pressure

0x00051584.name: solenoid_pressure_lc_b

0x00051618.name: solenoid_pressure_dispatch
0x00051618.comment: Solenoid pressure/apply tick: calls FUN_00051584 (LC/B), FUN_00051390 (apply bit), FUN_0005144c (clutch pressures).

0x0005162c.name: inhibitor_position_valid_flag

0x00051694.name: range_solenoid_dispatch

0x000516b0.name: solenoid_pattern_resolver

0x00051ec0.name: solenoid_pattern_downshift_map
0x00051ec0.comment: Remaps a solenoid pattern code one step toward lower gear (0x80->0x80,0x81->0x85,0x82->0x81,0x83->0x82). Pattern sequence step-down table.

0x00051f88.name: manual_range_pattern_step

0x00052428.name: failsafe_pattern_select

0x0005249c.name: failsafe_pattern_from_switches

0x00052578.name: gear_to_pattern_lookup
0x00052578.comment: Returns solenoid pattern code from ROM table 0x1c379 indexed by gear param_1&0xff.

0x0005258c.name: pattern_to_gear_lookup
0x0005258c.comment: Returns gear index from ROM table 0x1c37e indexed by pattern param_1&0xf (inverse of gear_to_pattern).

0x000525ac.name: pattern_step_clamp
0x000525ac.comment: Reads step count from ROM table 0x1c38d by pattern&0x7f, increments/decrements per param_2 (clamped 0..4); returns 0xff for invalid pattern.

0x000525fc.name: pattern_final_lookup
0x000525fc.comment: Returns final solenoid pattern code from ROM table 0x1c39a indexed by param_1&0xff.

0x00052624.name: solenoid_feedback_decode
0x00052624.comment: Decodes solenoid on/off feedback: snapshots DAT_00805510 to DAT_008042f4, and when enabled builds index from fluid-pressure switch bits DAT_008054fc into ROM table 0x1c31b to set DAT_00805510 low nibble (actual gear-solenoid state) and integrity flag DAT_008055a4 bit7; else masks pattern off.

0x00052818.name: latch_active_pattern
0x00052818.comment: Latches next solenoid pattern DAT_008047f8/f9 into active DAT_008047f3/f6 for this control cycle.

0x0005282c.name: manual_hold_ratio_flag
0x0005282c.comment: Manages DAT_0080567c low bits (manual-hold/ratio-lock) from solenoid state DAT_00805510 and speed/torque thresholds DAT_00804834/0080436e/DAT_00804f7a etc.; special path for lever position 4 (manual).

0x00052a58.name: manual_hold_timers
0x00052a58.comment: Ramps manual-hold timers DAT_00804370/0080436e while DAT_0080567c bits 1/0 set and pattern index DAT_0080487f unchanged (DAT_0080483f); resets otherwise.

0x00052af4.name: manual_range_request_state

0x00052c4c.name: shift_schedule_threshold_lookup

0x00052dc8.name: clear_shift_hold_timers
0x00052dc8.comment: Zeroes DAT_00804908 and DAT_00804914 (shift hold/dwell counters).

0x00052ddc.name: gear_hold_inhibit_timer
0x00052ddc.comment: Manages hold flag DAT_008056dc bit4 and counter DAT_00804840 (vs threshold DAT_0000807f) from lever mode DAT_00804842 and select-switch flags DAT_00805510/008056e0.

0x00052e98.name: auto_gear_select
0x00052e98.comment: Core gear-selection: uses FUN_00052c4c up/down thresholds, throttle DAT_008047e8, and speed/mode inputs to increment/decrement target gear DAT_0080483b (clamped 0-4) and flag a shift in DAT_008056dc bit2.

0x0005307c.name: input_switch_debounce_map
0x0005307c.comment: Reads inhibitor/switch ports via FUN_0002a2fc/FUN_0002a240/FUN_0002a344, XOR-debounces (DAT_0001c2e8/c2e9) into DAT_008047ed/ef, sets packed inhibitor DAT_008047f2=DAT_008047ef&0x1f, and maps solenoid-monitor bits (DAT_00804963/964/960/95f) into fields 0x805508/0x8054fc/0x8055c0; calls FUN_00053790/FUN_000537d8.

0x00053790.name: pressure_switch_all_on_flag
0x00053790.comment: Sets DAT_0080566c bit0 when fluid-pressure switch bits 3-6 of DAT_008055c0 are all grounded, else clears.

0x000537d8.name: pressure_switch_status_pack

0x00053858.name: turbine_output_speed_ratio
0x00053858.comment: Computes speed ratio DAT_008042d0 = (DAT_008042ce*(N+0x400)-DAT_008042cc*N)>>10 (N=DAT_0000803e), clamped to 10000; uses cal DAT_00012f3a when _DAT_00805644 bits0-1 set.

0x000539c4.name: shift_elapsed_timer

0x00053a14.name: shift_phase1_time_lookup
0x00053a14.comment: Looks up phase-timing table (&PTR_DAT_0000a324)[DAT_0080487f] by speed DAT_008044d2/temp DAT_00804816 and range codes DAT_00804887/885, deriving DAT_00804478; compares timer DAT_00804520 to set DAT_00805550 bit3.

0x00053cd8.name: temp_shift_time_lookup

0x000549c8.name: shift_completion_pressure_check

0x00054b80.name: upshift_finalize

0x00054e04.name: shift_timeout_abort
0x00054e04.comment: When in manual (DAT_00805524) checks elapsed DAT_00804476 against table (&PTR_DAT_00009a94)[gear]; on timeout with gear mismatch forces phase states to 0xff and sets DAT_00805554 abort bits.

0x00054ea8.name: shift_end_reset
0x00054ea8.comment: Detects both apply/release phases complete (=0xff); resets full shift state and restores default pressure/timer variables from DAT_000086c2..c8, latching gear and clearing direction DAT_0080487e.

0x0005500c.name: shift_control_dispatch

0x00055070.comment: 2D apply-side pressure/time table lookup at base 0x88d4 (or 0x8cc4 when DAT_00805534 bit2 set), row param_1*0x12, col param_2*2.

0x00055100.name: shift_progress_status_flag

0x000551ac.name: atf_temp1_filter

0x000553f4.name: apply_pressure_slew_hlrc
0x000553f4.comment: Rate-limits apply-pressure DAT_008043b4 toward target DAT_008044da (step id 4) via FUN_0003385c; saves state DAT_00804564/562.

0x0005542c.name: pressure_slew_fb
0x0005542c.comment: Rate-limits DAT_00804482 toward DAT_008043ea (step id 8) via FUN_0003385c; saves DAT_0080456a/568.

0x00055464.name: release_pressure_slew

0x0005549c.name: pressure_slew_dc_pl
0x0005549c.comment: Rate-limits DAT_00804484 toward DAT_00804408 (step 0x20) and DAT_00804486 toward DAT_0080440a (step 0x40) via FUN_0003385c.

0x00055500.name: pressure_offset_lookup

0x00055580.name: apply_pressure_base_calc
0x00055580.comment: DAT_008043b4 = DAT_008044bc + DAT_0080448c + DAT_0080452e (clamped 0..0xffff), or 0 if offset DAT_0080448c==0.

0x000555d0.name: shift_pressure_table_3d
0x000555d0.comment: 3-level nested table walk (PTR_DAT_0000dce8 or e340 by DAT_00805534 bit2) indexed by gear/temp DAT_00804813, speed DAT_008044d2, throttle DAT_00804816, yielding DAT_00804488 and DAT_0080448a.

0x000556f4.name: apply_pressure_ramp_dc
0x000556f4.comment: First pass sets DAT_008043b4 = DAT_008044bc+DAT_00804488+DAT_00804530 (flag DAT_0080555c bit0), thereafter accumulates DAT_0080448a; clamps 0..0xffff.

0x000557b4.name: release_pressure_ramp
0x000557b4.comment: First pass sets DAT_008043a4 = DAT_008044be+DAT_00804488+DAT_00804530 (flag DAT_00805558 bit0), then accumulates DAT_0080448a; clamped.

0x000558b4.name: pressure_fb_slew_offset

0x00055a90.name: apply_pressure_temp_comp

0x00055b2c.name: release_pressure_temp_comp

0x00055bc8.name: pressure_fb_decay
0x00055bc8.comment: Decays DAT_00804482 by DAT_008043e8 (floor 0, guard band 200).

0x00055bf4.name: pressure_dc_pl_decay

0x00055c48.name: apply_pressure_slew_summed
0x00055c48.comment: Slews DAT_00804562 toward DAT_008044da (step 4) then DAT_008043b4 = result + DAT_008044bc, clamped (0 if state 0).

0x00055ccc.comment: Slews DAT_00804562 toward DAT_008044de (step 0x10) then DAT_008043a4 = result + DAT_008044be, clamped.

0x00055d50.comment: Slews DAT_00804568 toward DAT_008043ea (step 8) then DAT_00804482 = result + DAT_008044c0, clamped.

0x00055ec8.name: shift_pressure_dispatch
0x00055ec8.comment: Large dispatcher selecting the correct release-side (DAT_00804874) and apply-side (DAT_00804875) pressure-ramp routine per shift phase and sub-state DAT_0080488f/00804890, split by direction DAT_0080487e (1=up,2=down).

0x000562d8.name: throttle_rate_class_index
0x000562d8.comment: Every other call rotates throttle history DAT_0080480b/810/47e8 and adjusts throttle-rate class index DAT_0080480c (0-7) using breakpoint table DAT_0001c35b/c35c.

0x0005636c.name: throttle_input_select

0x0005648c.name: init_apply_pressure_default
0x0005648c.comment: Sets DAT_008044da and DAT_008044f0 to default DAT_000086c6.

0x000564a0.name: apply_pressure_initial_lookup
